caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object with elaborate, ornamental carvings. The base and central portion display intricate scrollwork and leaf motifs in shades of ivory and grey, with accents of gold highlighting certain features such as the leaves and edges. Near the top of the object, there is a horizontal band decorated with diagonal hatching rendered in a light beige or white color, bordered by a gilt rope-like trim. The very top of the object has a round, fabric-like cover depicted in a mix of green, brown, and red areas, suggesting a patterned textile. The background is a solid, light beige color without any additional objects or elements.
title: Mast Sheath
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
